about_the_game:
Bobcos is a vibrant 2D online multiplayer sandbox game where you can create, explore, and express yourself. Build your own personal world using blocks and decorative items, shape the environment to your liking, and bring your imagination to life.

From peaceful forests to bustling towns, your world is entirely yours to design. Customize your avatar with a wide variety of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles. Visit other players' worlds, chat, explore, and form friendships in a lively and welcoming community.

Trade items with friends, go fishing, and unlock rare collectibles. The game features a persistent online world—your progress, builds, and collections are always saved, even when you're offline.

Whether you're a builder, a collector, or someone who just wants to chill with others in a cozy virtual world, Bobcos offers a relaxing and endlessly creative multiplayer experience. With seasonal events and frequent updates, there’s always something new to discover.

  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 -2GB / AMD RX 460 -2GB
